meta.description: Vanilla 1.12 Warrior item proficiency and the rule proposed for the realm.
meta.source: vmangos world DB (github.com/vmangos/core release db_latest, sqlite) + 1.12.1 client DBCs

vanilla_notes: Cloth, leather, mail, shields and Block are known at creation.
Plate Mail (spell 750) is taught by Warrior trainers at level 40 (trainer spell 7109).
Weapon Masters teach every other Warrior weapon skill for 10s at any level; Polearms (trainer spell 15991) requires level 20.
Starting weapon skills differ by race (see starting_weapon_skills_by_race); a Warrior without a skill cannot equip that weapon type until trained.
Fist weapons were trainable by Warriors (spell 15590 via 15992).
proposed_realm_rule: can_equip(item) = item.required_level <= level AND (allowable_class == -1 OR allowable_class & 1) AND class/subclass level gate below is met. The slice has no Weapon Master, so every Warrior weapon type is known from level 1 except polearms (level 20); plate from level 40 (beyond the slice's level 30 cap, so never). Wands, librams, idols and totems are never usable.
